# Trailblazer

> An open-source (MIT) Jekyll theme for Salesforce developers: typed
> collections, courses with a lesson player, a printable YAML resume, a
> certification wall, and a token-first design system that re-brands from a
> single accent colour. No build step beyond Jekyll; every plugin runs on
> GitHub Pages.

This site is both the theme's landing page and its live demo — the demo
content is a fictional Salesforce-developer persona, and every feature links
to the page that proves it.

## Docs

- [Documentation index]({{ '/docs/' | absolute_url }}): the numbered setup path
- [Installing]({{ '/docs/installing/' | absolute_url }}): fork, gem or remote theme
- [Deploying]({{ '/docs/deploying/' | absolute_url }}): GitHub Pages end to end
- [Configuring]({{ '/docs/configuring/' | absolute_url }}): every _config.yml key

- [Components]({{ '/docs/components/' | absolute_url }}): the Markdown shortcodes
- [Customising]({{ '/docs/customising/' | absolute_url }}): tokens and overrides
